utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds lovely, Dane. When are you thinking of meeting for book club?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Maybe next Thursday evening would work for me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Next Thursday evening works for me too. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I can bring the book list and a couple of spare copies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. Could you also confirm which edition the spare copies are?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check and bring the edition details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll bring my book club notes, and if anyone needs a spare copy, I’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good, I might need that spare copy. I’ll try to remember my notes this time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll bring the spare copy for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t joined a book club before, but I’d be curious to hear what you’re reading.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds nice. We usually meet on Thursdays, and I can let you know what book we pick if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please do.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What night is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure, but I heard it might be Thursday evening.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thursday evening sounds right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club’s picking their next read tonight. If you’re going, I’d get there a little early.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I might swing by early, then. Saves me from scrambling for a seat.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, and once they start tossing around titles, it always takes them a while to settle on one. I’ll be curious to hear what they pick.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, book club is this Thursday at my place - you should come. I’ll text Opal the details too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep an eye out for your text.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll text you the details tonight so you have everything for Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I’d be glad to join the book club. What book are you all reading?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Which book did you pick?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I picked The Midnight Library. It seemed like a good one for everyone to discuss.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo. I’ve got the sign-up sheet ready if you want to pick a book for next month.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can pick one. Just hand me the sheet and I’ll write something down.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, here you go. I’ll make sure it gets back to you once you’ve written it down.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can ask around about the book club and see who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Let me know what you find, and I’ll set aside time for it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll ask around and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the book club. I think I was supposed to bring the list, but I might have left it somewhere again.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s all right, we can look for it after. I can still help with the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, that helps. I think I can still find it, and if not, we can just make a fresh list together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the book club’s picking up again. What are you reading next?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m thinking of starting the new memoir everyone’s talking about. If it’s good, I’ll bring it to the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds like a good pick. Let me know what you think, and if it’s a hit, I’ll bring something in the same vein next time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You should come to the book club this week, Dane - I think you'd fit right in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Maybe I should, if I can make it before the usual chaos starts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Then you’ve already got the right spirit. I’ll save you a seat before the room gets crowded.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the book club? I heard it’s been getting a bit more lively lately.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s fine by me, as long as they keep it orderly. A little lively is good, but I still like a clear start and finish.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds fair to me. A clear structure usually makes it easier to enjoy the lively part.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can make it after school if that works for the group.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me, Faye. I’ll let everyone know we can count you in after school.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Mara. I’ll see everyone after school then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the book club has been lively lately. You should come by sometime, Vik - I think you'd get along with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can come by sometime. Keep me posted on the next one.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll keep you posted when the next one’s set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my ladder if the book club needs anything set up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help, thanks. Just make sure it’s easy to set up and put away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I can keep it simple and easy to put away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can bring the book club notes by my place if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would help a lot, thanks, Opal. I’ll make sure we’re set when you swing by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ll have them ready when you stop by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the book club meet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet, so let me check the details before I answer.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds good to me. When is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re meeting Thursday evening at my place.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thursday evening works for me. Want me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the book club's meeting got moved, but I don't know the details yet. Did Noah mention where it's happening?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it’s at Marcy’s place now, but I may be mixing that up. Sorry, I missed the update.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds right, thanks. If you hear the exact address, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the book club meets Tuesday at your place, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, Tuesday at my place. I’ll send the time and a reminder tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, so Tuesday at your place is confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good timing - I heard the book club is picking the next title tonight, so I should be able to stop by and hear what they choose.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m curious what they pick; if it’s a good one, I’ll try to make the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the book club. I might have missed the last meeting, but I’m still keen to join in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries, you can still come along to the next one. I’ll send you the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks. Just send me the details when you can.
